findings.passage: If there is any place where we should be able to agree that we don't need the presence of guns, it's in higher education.

findings.passage: If there is any place where we should be able to agree that we don’t need the presence of guns, it’s in higher [education] and definitely not in our hospitals,
findings.note: Quoted in a student newspaper story on her remarks at the regents' University Affairs Committee meeting, where she said she would formally move to ban concealed carry on all CU campuses.

findings.motion: Proposed amendment to CU Regent Policy 14.I (weapons control) to ban permit holders from carrying concealed handguns on all campuses
findings.note: A news story reports that she brought a proposed change to the regents' weapons policy. It would replace wording that protects the right to carry under the state concealed-carry law with a ban on concealed handguns by permit holders on all campuses, with exceptions for educational programs, jobs requiring firearms and authorized teams. A later news story reports the regents did not adopt it; the regents' own minutes were not located.
